title: Slicing a Sub-grid
entry_point: crop(a, top, left, h, w); every_other(a); border_sum(a)
hints: Check `top + h <= a.shape[0]` and `left + w <= a.shape[1]`.
Border = total − interior `a[1:-1, 1:-1].sum()` (the interior is empty for small arrays).

failure_feedback.advice: Return `.copy()` of the slice so modifying the crop doesn't modify the input.
Slicing silently clips; check the bounds yourself.
For 1×1 or 2×2 arrays the interior is empty, so the border is everything.
Use a[top:top+h, left:left+w] (one bracket, comma between axes).
